description: A Java class in an Akka Streams-based project that defines a final utility class 'Filter' for creating stream components that filter messages based on their type and a predicate. The class provides static methods to generate graph stages for filtering and multiplexing messages, used within a larger Akka Streams processing pipeline.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create Akka Stream graph stages for filtering messages by type and predicate, multiplexing messages, and separating messages based on success or failure in type matching.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a filtering graph stage for messages of a specific class T that satisfy a predicate. It filters messages by checking their class type and predicate result, passing only matching messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a filtering graph stage for messages of a specific class T without predicate filtering, passing all messages that are instances of T.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a graph to split messages into accepted and rejected streams based on an optional mapping function.

methods.name: multiplexByEither
methods.description: Creates a graph to split messages into two streams based on an Either mapper function, separating accepted and rejected messages.

methods.name: multiplexByEitherFlow
methods.description: Creates a graph to split messages based on a flow that produces Either<Rejected, Accepted> messages, routing them accordingly.
